title: Evaluation of a coefficient hypothesis
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and let a low-degree coefficient hypothesis be given. Its evaluation is the Boolean function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ obtained by evaluating its coefficient array.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of the evaluation map and coefficient arrays.
